caption: The two operator lines produce the values that feed the final sum: 250 × 3 gives $total 750, 18% of 750 gives $gst 135, and 750 + 135 gives the ₹885 that echo prints. Notice that each box holds one value and one type — no type is ever declared.

spec.title: Worked example: pay.php
spec.aria: A top-down flow where $price 250 and $qty 3 multiply into $total 750, which gives $gst 135 at 18 percent and, added back to $total, gives $pay 885, which echo prints as Pay: ₹885.
